title: Opportunity
description: Cross-source pain opportunity row for Pulse. opportunity_id MUST be stable across days: hash of product_key|normalized_pain (never daily-random). Optional additive fields: lane, url, unmet_demand, competition_density, teardown_status, teardown_ref. CSV path: data/opportunities/YYYY-MM-DD.csv (+ jsonl OK). Cards above WATCH require competitive teardown (see competitive_teardown.md).

opportunity_id.description: Stable key across days: hash of product_key|normalized_pain (e.g. opp-{sha256-8}). Not daily-random.

sources_json.description: JSON array of source names as a string, or blank

suggested_next.description: Pulse next step. DROP? = demoted OEM-in-stock / zero buyer evidence (Track A).

url.description: Optional additive column — representative evidence URL

unmet_demand.description: Track A: rider unmet demand 0..100 (not competition)

competition_density.description: Track A: Etsy/MW/OEM-substitute density 0..1 (punishes, never boosts unmet)

teardown_status.description: Required non-empty when suggested_next above WATCH

teardown_ref.description: Path or Drive id of teardown companion
